authority.basis: Approved D01-D10/E01-E09 and deterministic calculation remain authoritative. Public context does not grant physical identity, check deletion, datum matching or scale precedence.

adoption.behavior: Explicit parent dimension edit/review panel, change reason, original/replacement value and exact evidence history. Bounded parent replacement and child lineage are local provenance decisions, not a Bluebeam requirement.
checks: retained parent dimension repair submits only existing reading changes and never exposes route or check deletion
retained parent reading history compares original and corrected source regions after the correction

adoption.behavior: Keep exact original view, capture and scale identities; fresh replacement requires current evidence. Preserve partial coverage and unresolved source errors for still-used references. Reopening uses saved evidence without inference.
D05 keeps a material written/scaled whole-run conflict unresolved. Correcting a reading does not remove its check, move the path, or force child quantities.

Strict IDs, exact current parent/reading/source pins, explicit foreign relationship review, append-only events and atomic saves implement local approved provenance. Missing applicability cannot be inferred from the public sources.
Electrical tag matching is not transferred to duct identity or source replacement. Equal text or quantities do not authorize an enclosing membership update or physical correspondence.

local_correction_decisions.shared_evidence: Replacing one parent reading removes only its obsolete local reference. Other portions keep their required reference; all captures remain in history.
local_correction_decisions.recovery_metadata: Selected saved source geometry supports recovery. Quantity always uses separately validated current source bytes and assignments.
local_correction_decisions.inherited_evidence_limit: Child/admission bytes remain fixed. Inherited same-page evidence still required elsewhere remains unresolved when unavailable; no blanket unused-reference exemption.

verification_state: PASS; scoped capability locally implemented, independently reviewed and verified; full goal active/incomplete

external_activity.decision: Reuse exact verified retained findings; no new mechanical requirement or changed source evidence. No external submission log event is needed for a local-only reuse.

limits: Indexed text snapshots retain original URLs/source/notebook IDs and retrieval dates in the linked findings; reuse is not fresh publisher verification.
